about: Every judgement call in the glossary (content/snowmoon/glossary.json, built by scripts/build-glossary.ts). The build applies these and nothing else: no model is asked anything at build time or at runtime. merge joins spellings of one word under the first-named term; add brings in capitalised in-world terms the narration's pronunciation file has no entry for; exclude drops a candidate; entity_covered records entity-name runs that are already terms by another spelling. not_explanations lists sentences the explanation rule picks that do not explain the term. Drafted by the coding agent on 2026-10-09 from the book text; reviewed by the owner (FID 6786) on 2026-10-09.
